entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A werewolf planeswalker and protector of the Ulvenwald who once concealed her lycanthropy as an archmage of Goldnight, slaughtered her comrades during a transformation, and now returns to save Rembert.

entities.name: Archmage Rembert
entities.description: An archmage of Goldnight and Arlinn's former mentor, scarred by her claws, who now hunts her as a monster.

entities.name: Archmage Reeves
entities.description: An archmage who performs Arlinn's ceremony and dies when she transforms.

entities.name: Cathar Leighton
entities.description: A cathar who warns of the devil attack on Havengul and dies later.

entities.name: Olaylie
entities.description: An angel of Flight Goldnight who protects Arlinn and the boy at Havengul and is killed by Arlinn's werewolf form.

entities.name: Freydalia
entities.description: An angel who blesses a small church in Havengul as a sanctuary.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel of Innistrad, fallen and destroyed, whose blessing Arlinn once hoped would cure her.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane descending into madness after Avacyn's destruction.

entities.name: Lambholt
entities.description: A town under siege by a mad angel.

entities.name: Havengul
entities.description: A town set ablaze by devils and defended by the Goldnight.

entities.name: Elgaud Grounds
entities.description: The grounds with a small chapel where Arlinn is made an archmage.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A region of Innistrad where Avacyn's churches stand.

entities.name: Goldnight
entities.description: A flight of angels and archmages and cathars bound by sacrament to Avacyn.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: Holy soldiers of Avacyn's church, some of whom fight the mad angel and Arlinn.

entities.name: Mondronen Werewolf Pack
entities.description: The werewolf pack whose howls cursed Arlinn.

entities.name: Devils
entities.description: Cackling needle-fingered creatures that burn Havengul and tear at Olaylie.

entities.name: Mantle of Goldnight
entities.description: A thick gold chain with a shining medallion symbolizing Avacyn's love and protection, worn by archmages of Goldnight.

events.summary: Arlinn, in wolf form, races toward the besieged town of Lambholt smelling angel's blood.
events.quote: The aroma met Arlinn's wide wolf nostrils as she raced up the sheer incline of a gorge toward the town of Lambholt under siege.

events.summary: Arlinn witnessed a mad angel's descent on Lambholt, which left cathars and civilians slain.
events.quote: She had witnessed the mad angel's descent on Lambholt from afar

events.summary: Flashback: Arlinn, secretly a lycanthrope, is presented the Mantle of Goldnight and made an archmage in the Elgaud chapel.
events.quote: At the correct moment, Arlinn bowed her head, and Reeves slipped the chain around her neck.

events.summary: Flashback: Arlinn hopes the blessing will repress her curse, since a lycanthrope cannot be an archmage.
events.quote: A lycanthrope could not be an archmage of Goldnight, and Arlinn had to become an archmage of Goldnight.

events.summary: Flashback: Cathar Leighton interrupts the ceremony with news of a devil attack on Havengul.
events.quote: Devils in Havengul! Hordes of them!

events.summary: Flashback: Rembert declares Arlinn an archmage and one of the Goldnight despite the unfinished ceremony.
events.quote: You are one of the Goldnight, Arlinn Kord, bound by the sacrament that holds us together

events.summary: Flashback: The Goldnight find Havengul ablaze with devils.
events.quote: They found the town of Havengul ablaze.

events.summary: Flashback: The angel Freydalia blesses a small church as a sanctuary for the injured.
events.quote: An angel, Freydalia, blessed a small church, casting a spell of protection over it

events.summary: Flashback: Arlinn prays to Avacyn and pulls a boy from under a collapsing carriage with divine strength.
events.quote: As the boy's hand touched hers, Arlinn yanked him out from under the carriage with a divine might that sent them both rolling across the ground just as the carriage collapsed.

events.summary: Flashback: Devils swarm Olaylie, cutting her and making her bleed.
events.quote: Olaylie was lurching through the sky with a devil on her back.

events.summary: Arlinn finds a mad angel bound in a clearing, surrounded by cathars.
events.quote: The angel was bound with rope, an arrow protruding from her gut, wings bloodied.

events.summary: Arlinn sees Rembert, whose three long scars shine in the moonlight.
events.quote: Though Rembert's face was red from effort and crusted in dirt, the three long, white scars that ran across his cheek and down his jaw shone in the moonlight.

events.summary: A branch snaps and the mad angel points out Arlinn the werewolf to the cathars.
events.quote: There in the trees! A monster!

events.summary: Distracted cathars step back, and the mad angel breaks her ropes and takes flight.
events.quote: In a display of mad strength, she spread her wings with enough force to cast off the ropes that bound her.

events.summary: The mad angel hurls an arrow that kills the youngest cathar.
events.quote: she tore the arrow from her gut and hurled it down at the youngest of the cathars.

events.summary: Rembert attacks Arlinn with a branch and orders the cathars to kill the monster.
events.quote: Rembert was wielding the branch as a weapon, against her.

events.summary: Flashback: Arlinn hands the rescued boy to Rembert and races back to fight the devils attacking Olaylie.
events.quote: Archmage Arlinn Kord thrust the small child into Rembert's outstretched arms.

events.summary: Flashback: Devils yank on Olaylie's wings, bringing her crashing to the ground.
events.quote: In unison, they heaved back, yanking on the angel's wings, sending Olaylie plummeting to the ground.

events.summary: Flashback: Devils pin Arlinn as she prays to Avacyn and receives no answer.
events.quote: She waited, opening herself to the power of the protector; she needed power to save the angel.

events.summary: Flashback: Olaylie's agonized cry makes Arlinn lose herself and transform into a werewolf.
events.quote: Arlinn felt the power of the pain in Olaylie's cry, and just like the night, she came apart.

events.summary: Flashback: The werewolf tears into the devils.
events.quote: The werewolf surged at the devils.

events.summary: Flashback: The werewolf pulls Olaylie down and attacks her.
events.quote: The werewolf pulled the angel back to the ground and laid into its flesh with teeth.

events.summary: Flashback: The werewolf kills the cathars who try to stop her, one by one.
events.quote: One after another. They all fell at the werewolf's mercy.

events.summary: Flashback: The werewolf tears the wings off Olaylie and kills her.
events.quote: Tore it full off the angel's body.

events.summary: Flashback: Rembert recognizes Arlinn, and she sees the bodies of Leighton, Reeves and the other cathars.
events.quote: Fallen cathars. Too many of them.

events.summary: Flashback: The werewolf slashes Rembert's cheek, leaving his scars, as he prepares to strike her down.
events.quote: her claws digging trenches into his cheek

events.summary: Flashback: As Rembert's sword falls, Arlinn planeswalks away to another world.
events.quote: she had planeswalked that day, so long ago, when her mind had cleaved.

events.summary: On another world Arlinn lives as a werewolf with a human mind and learns that she must trust herself to be whole.
events.quote: She had to trust herself to be whole.

events.summary: Arlinn returns to Innistrad, visits graves and confesses in churches and to angels.
events.quote: she had visited the graves, Reeves's, Leighton's, all of them.

events.summary: Arlinn tries to seek Rembert's forgiveness; he calls her a monster and orders her away from Elgaud Grounds.
events.quote: Leave these grounds, and never come back.

events.summary: Cornered at the gorge by Rembert and the cathars, Arlinn braces for blows.
events.quote: She was surrounded, backed against the edge of the gorge, cathars on all sides and Rembert before her

events.summary: The mad angel seizes Rembert and carries him into the air.
events.quote: The angel shrieked as it closed its bloody fingers around Rembert's arms and pulled him, gasping and wide-eyed, into the air.

events.summary: Arlinn leaps up, pulls the angel to the ground and kills her, freeing Rembert.
events.quote: The mad angel was dead in the matter of moments.

events.summary: Rembert is wounded, lying on a dead tree trunk in the gorge, and Arlinn climbs out to reach him.
events.quote: Rembert was wounded, lying on a twisted trunk of a dead tree

events.summary: Arlinn transforms to human form and offers Rembert her hand; he admits she lied and killed the others, yet takes it.
events.quote: Arlinn closed her eyes and welcomed the transformation to her human form

events.summary: Arlinn tells Rembert that Avacyn is gone and they must find strength in each other.
events.quote: We must find strength in each other.

relations.note: He pushed and helped hone her strengths.
relations.quote: a mentor who had pushed her, been patient with her, and helped her to hone her strengths

relations.note: Declared one of the Goldnight by Rembert.
relations.quote: You are one of the Goldnight, Arlinn Kord, bound by the sacrament that holds us together

relations.note: He stands on the altar of Goldnight as an archmage.
relations.quote: Archmage Reeves stood on the altar of Goldnight

relations.note: In werewolf form she rips her wings off.
relations.quote: away from the broken, bloodied, lifeless angel Olaylie

relations.note: Among the cathars killed during her transformation.
relations.quote: away from the body of Archmage Reeves at her feet

relations.note: Among the fallen cathars she recognizes.
relations.quote: She knew them all. Leighton. Reeves.

relations.note: Estranged since she scarred him, he banishes and then fights her, but she saves his life.
relations.quote: If I ever see you again, I will strike you down.
She was the protector of the Ulvenwald.

relations.note: Their howls cursed her with lycanthropy.
relations.quote: after the howls of the Mondronen werewolf pack had cursed her
